title: Hikâye anlatma
canDo: Başımdan geçen bir olayı duygularımla birlikte, sıralı ve bağlantılı bir şekilde anlatabilir; neden ve sonuçları açıklayabilirim.
grammar: sıralama: first, then, after that, finally, in the end
past simple ve past continuous ile hikâye

liveClass.title: Hikâye zinciri
liveClass.goal: Öğretmen bir hikâyenin ilk cümlesini verir ('It was a dark, rainy night and I was waiting for the last bus...'). Her öğrenci sırayla bir cümle ekler ve verilen bir kelimeyi kullanmak zorundadır (suddenly, luckily, so, because, embarrassed...). Sonra gruplar kendi gerçek ya da uydurma hikâyelerini hazırlayıp anlatır; dinleyenler tepki verir ve soru sorar.

learn.explanation:
Birçok duygu sıfatının iki hali vardır:

| -ed → kişi ne **hissediyor** | -ing → şey / kişi nasıl **bir etki yaratıyor** |
|---|---|
| I was **bored**. (Sıkıldım.) | The film was **boring**. (Film sıkıcıydı.) |
| She's **interested** in art. | Art is **interesting**. |
| We were **tired**. | The walk was **tiring**. |
| He was **surprised**. | The news was **surprising**. |
| I was **embarrassed**. | It was **embarrassing**. |
| They were **frightened**. | The story was **frightening**. |

**Dikkat:** "I'm boring" = Ben sıkıcı biriyim! Sıkıldığınızı söylemek için **I'm bored** deyin.

**Vurgulamak:** so / really / very / a bit: I was **so** excited! / It was **a bit** disappointing.

examples.en: I was really excited about my first flight.
The museum was interesting, but the tour was tiring.
We were disappointed because the beach was dirty.
examples.tr: Plaj kirli olduğu için hayal kırıklığına uğradık.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "sıkıldım" ve "sıkıcı" farklı kelimeler olduğu için fark kolay anlaşılır, ama İngilizcede iki kelime birbirine çok benzediğinden karıştırılır. Kural: insanın içindeki duygu → -ed; bu duyguyu yaratan şey → -ing. "I'm interesting in music" yanlış; doğrusu "I'm interested in music".

lessons.title: Çünkü, bu yüzden, ama
lessons.goal: because, so, but ve and ile cümleleri bağlayıp neden ve sonuçları açıklayabilirim.

discover.title: Kötü bir gün
discover.body:
Yesterday was a terrible day. My alarm didn't ring, so I woke up late. I didn't have time for breakfast and I ran to the bus stop. I missed the bus, so I took a taxi. The taxi was expensive, but I arrived at work on time.

Then I realised that I didn't have my laptop because I left it at home! I called my brother and he brought it to the office. I was annoyed, but I was also grateful. In the evening I went to bed at nine because I was so tired.

questions.prompt: Why did the writer wake up late?
questions.explanation: "My alarm didn't ring, so I woke up late."
"I called my brother and he brought it"

learn.explanation:
**Bağlaçlar** iki cümleyi birleştirir:

| Bağlaç | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **and** | ve (ekleme) | I ran **and** I caught the bus. |
| **but** | ama (zıtlık) | It was expensive, **but** it was fast. |
| **because** | çünkü (**sebep**) | I was late **because** I missed the bus. |
| **so** | bu yüzden (**sonuç**) | I missed the bus, **so** I was late. |

**because ve so aynı durumu iki yönden anlatır:**

- I was tired **because** I worked all day. (sebep → because'dan sonra)
- I worked all day, **so** I was tired. (sonuç → so'dan sonra)

**Virgül:** but ve so'dan önce genellikle virgül konur. because öndeyse: **Because** it was raining, we stayed at home.

examples.en: It was raining, so we took a taxi.
examples.tr: Yağmur yağıyordu, bu yüzden taksiye bindik.

examples.en: We took a taxi because it was raining.
The hotel was old, but it was very clean.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede sebep genellikle önce gelir ("Yağmur yağdığı için taksiye bindik"); İngilizcede because cümlesi çoğunlukla sonra gelir. "So" bağlacını "so tired" (çok yorgun) ile karıştırmayın: I was so tired (çok yorgundum) / I was tired, so I slept (yorgundum, bu yüzden uyudum).

lessons.title: Önce, sonra, en sonunda
lessons.goal: Sıralama ifadeleriyle olayları doğru sırayla anlatabilirim.

learn.explanation:
**Sıralama ifadeleri** dinleyenin hikâyeyi takip etmesini kolaylaştırır.

| Başlangıç | Orta | Son |
|---|---|---|
| **First,** ... | **Then** ... | **Finally,** ... |
| **At first,** ... | **After that,** ... | **In the end,** ... |
| **One day,** ... | **Next,** ... | |
| | **Later,** ... | |

- **At first** = ilk başta (sonra durum değişti): **At first** I was scared, but then I loved it.
- **Finally** = bir listenin son adımı ya da uzun bekleyişin sonu: **Finally**, the bus came.
- **In the end** = her şeyden sonra, sonuç olarak: **In the end**, we had a great time.

**Zaman bağlaçları:**

- **when**: **When** I got home, I had a shower.
- **after** + isim / cümle: **After** dinner, we went for a walk.
- **before** + isim / cümle: **Before** I left, I locked the door.

examples.en: At first I didn't like him, but then we became friends.
examples.tr: İlk başta ondan hoşlanmadım ama sonra arkadaş olduk.

examples.en: After that, we went to a café.
Before I went to bed, I checked my emails.

learn.turkishNote: "Then" ile "after that" aynı anlamdadır; sürekli "and then, and then" demek yerine çeşitlilik hikâyeyi daha akıcı yapar. "At the end" bir şeyin sonunda (at the end of the film), "in the end" ise sonuç olarak anlamındadır.

options: At first I was scared, but then I loved it.
In the end I was scared, but first I loved it.

task.prompt: Kuzey gibi, ilk kez denediğiniz bir şeyi (yemek yapmak, araba sürmek, bir sınav, yeni bir iş...) sıralama ifadeleriyle anlatın (70–90 kelime). En az 5 farklı sıralama ifadesi kullanın.
task.modelAnswer: My first driving lesson was terrible! At first, I was very nervous. First, the teacher showed me the car. Then I started the engine, but I pressed the wrong pedal. After that, I drove very slowly around the car park. Later, we went onto a real road. When a bus came behind us, I was so frightened! In the end, the teacher said I did well, and I felt proud.

lessons.title: Aniden!
lessons.goal: Hikâye zarflarıyla bir olayı daha canlı anlatabilir ve arka planla olayları ayırabilirim.

discover.title: Kısa hikâye: Kayıp yüzük
discover.body:
It was a beautiful summer evening. My husband and I were walking along the beach in Çeşme. The sun was going down and children were playing in the sand.

Suddenly, I realised that my wedding ring wasn't on my finger! I was so worried. We looked everywhere, but unfortunately it was getting dark.

Then a little girl ran towards us. She was holding something shiny. "Is this yours?" she asked. Luckily, it was my ring! I was so relieved that I nearly cried. To say thank you, we bought her the biggest ice cream on the beach.

questions.prompt: How did the writer feel when she got the ring back?
questions.explanation: "I was so relieved that I nearly cried"

learn.explanation:
**Hikâye zarfları** dinleyene ne hissetmesi gerektiğini gösterir. Genellikle **cümle başında, virgülle** kullanılır.

| Zarf | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **Suddenly,** | aniden (beklenmedik olay) | **Suddenly,** the lights went out. |
| **Luckily,** / **Fortunately,** | neyse ki (iyi haber) | **Luckily,** nobody was hurt. |
| **Unfortunately,** | ne yazık ki (kötü haber) | **Unfortunately,** the shop was closed. |
| **Amazingly,** | inanılmaz bir şekilde | **Amazingly,** we won! |

**Hikâyenin zamanları (2. üniteyi hatırlayalım):**

- **Arka plan:** past continuous → We **were walking** on the beach.
- **Olaylar:** past simple → Suddenly, I **realised** ...
- **Durum ve duygular:** was / were + sıfat → I **was** so worried.

**so + sıfat + that** → o kadar ... ki: I was **so** relieved **that** I nearly cried.

examples.en: Unfortunately, we missed the last train.
examples.tr: Ne yazık ki son treni kaçırdık.

examples.en: Luckily, a kind man helped us.
examples.tr: Neyse ki nazik bir adam bize yardım etti.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "neyse ki", "maalesef" gibi ifadeler de cümle başında kullanılır, bu yüzden bu zarflar kolayca öğrenilir. En sık hata, hikâyede her şeyi past simple ile anlatmaktır; arka plan için past continuous kullanmak hikâyeyi çok daha canlı yapar.

practice.text: We ___ walking home when it started to rain.
I was ___ happy that I started to dance. (o kadar)
___, nobody was hurt in the accident. (neyse ki)

practice.audioText: We were having dinner in a restaurant when suddenly the lights went out. Unfortunately, it was a power cut in the whole area. Luckily, the waiters brought candles.

task.prompt: JAI'ye kısa bir hikâye anlatın (gerçek ya da uydurma): arka planı past continuous ile verin, sonra Suddenly ile bir olay, Unfortunately ile bir sorun ve Luckily ile bir çözüm ekleyin. Duygularınızı da söyleyin.
task.modelAnswer: I was waiting for my flight in Rome. People were sleeping on the chairs. Suddenly, I heard my name on the speakers. Unfortunately, my flight was cancelled! I was so annoyed. Luckily, the airline gave me a free hotel room, and in the end I had an extra day in Rome.

lessons.title: Hikâyeni anlat
lessons.goal: A2'de öğrendiklerimi kullanarak başımdan geçen bir olayı baştan sona akıcı bir şekilde anlatabilirim.

lines.speaker: Melis
lines.text: You won't believe what happened to me last week!

lines.speaker: Arda
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: Melis
lines.text: Well, I was taking the metro to work. I was very tired, so I fell asleep.

lines.speaker: Arda
lines.text: Oh no! Did you miss your stop?

lines.speaker: Melis
lines.text: Yes! When I woke up, I was at the last station. At first I was really worried, because I had an important meeting.

lines.speaker: Arda
lines.text: So what did you do?

lines.speaker: Melis
lines.text: I called my boss. Luckily, the meeting was cancelled! In the end, I just had a coffee and went back. But I was so embarrassed!

lines.speaker: Arda
lines.text: Ha ha! That's so funny. That's happened to me too!

questions.explanation: "I was very tired, so I fell asleep."

learn.explanation:
**İyi bir hikâyenin yapısı:**

1. **Giriş (dikkat çek):** You won't believe what happened! / Did I tell you about ...?
2. **Arka plan (ne zaman, nerede, ne oluyordu?):** Last week, I **was taking** the metro ...
3. **Olaylar (sırayla):** First / Then / When / Suddenly + past simple
4. **Sorun ve çözüm:** Unfortunately ... / Luckily ...
5. **Son ve duygu:** In the end ... / I was so relieved!

**Dinleyen olarak:**

- Tepki: Oh no! / Really? / That's so funny!
- Soru: What happened next? / So what did you do? / How did you feel?
- Benzer deneyim: **That's happened to me too!** (present perfect, 6. ünite)

A2 seviyesinde öğrendiğiniz her şey bu derste bir araya geliyor: past simple, past continuous, bağlaçlar, sıralama, duygu sıfatları ve tepki ifadeleri.

examples.en: Did I tell you about my trip to Van?

learn.turkishNote: İngilizcede hikâye anlatırken dinleyenin araya girip soru sorması ve tepki vermesi beklenir; bu bir kabalık değil, ilgi göstergesidir. Hikâyeyi anlatan kişi de dinleyenin tepkilerine kısa cevaplarla karşılık verir (Yes! / I know!) ve hikâyeye devam eder.

task.prompt: A2 final görevi: JAI'ye başınızdan geçen gerçek bir olayı 1–2 dakika boyunca anlatın. Hikâye yapısının 5 bölümünü kullanın. JAI sorular soracak; cevap verip hikâyeye devam edin.
task.modelAnswer: Did I tell you about my trip to Kars? It was January and it was snowing heavily. We were driving to the hotel when suddenly our car stopped. Unfortunately, there was no signal on our phones, so we couldn't call anyone. We were so frightened because it was very cold. Then a farmer came with his tractor. Luckily, he pulled our car to his village. In the end, his family gave us hot soup and we stayed with them. It was the best night of the trip!

questions.prompt: A2 final yazısı: Başınızdan geçen unutulmaz bir olayı anlatan bir hikâye yazın (100–120 kelime). Bir giriş kalıbı, past continuous ile arka plan, sıralama ifadeleri, because / so / but, Suddenly / Luckily / Unfortunately ve en az 3 duygu sıfatı kullanın.
questions.modelAnswer: Did I tell you about my sister's wedding? It was a hot day in July and everyone was dancing in the garden. I was so excited because I had to give a speech. First, I drank some water. Then I took the microphone. Suddenly, I realised my notes were in the car! I was really embarrassed, and my hands were shaking. Unfortunately, the car was far away, so I decided to speak without notes. At first it was difficult, but then people started laughing at my stories. In the end, my sister hugged me and said it was the best speech of the night. I was so proud and relieved!
